label: polybutylene succinate
definition: biodegradable thermoplastic polymer polyester that is synthesized via the polycondensation of succinic acid and 1,4-butanediol

label: polylactic acid
definition: biodegradable thermoplastic polymer produced from renewable resources such as corn starch

label: portion of bio-based plastic material
definition: A portion of synthetic plastic material that is composed of biobased polymer molecules.

label: portion of biodegradable plastic material
definition: A portion of plastic material that is constituted by biodegradable polymer molecules, is the main input of a process of biodegradation of plastic.

label: portion of compostable synthetic plastic material
definition: A portion of biodegradable synthetic plastic material that is copmosed of polymer molecules that bear a disposition to be degraded during a plastic composting process (compostability).

label: portion of natural plastic material
definition: A potion of plastic that is constituted of polymer molecules produced by processes whose agents do not include humans or their technologies.

label: portion of recyclable plastic material
definition: A portion of synthetic plastic material that is composed of recyclable polymer molecules.

label: portion of recycled plastic material
definition: A portion of synthetic plastic material that is composed of recycled polymer molecules.

label: portion of synthetic biodegradable plastic material
definition: A portion of plastic material that is composed of polymer molecules that are both synthetic and biodegradable.

label: portion of synthetic plastic material
definition: A portion of plastic that is composed of some synthetic polymer molecules.

label: portion of virgin plastic material
definition: A portion of plastic material that is composed by polymer molecules that have not been recycled.
